record.paper_title: Hadronic production of η–mesons: recent results and open questions
record.original_question: What mechanism explains the failure of models that reproduce the total pp → pp eta cross section to reproduce the pp invariant-mass spectrum near threshold? The alternatives to disentangle are a significant eta-nucleon interaction not captured by the existing model, an energy dependence of the production operator, and significant nucleon-nucleon P-wave contributions; a resolution should use observables such as the double-polarization observable Axx together with differential cross sections to isolate nucleon-nucleon P-waves and establish the partial-wave decomposition of the pp eta spectrum.

evidence.quote: However, it turned out that the pp invariant mass spectrum measured for pp → ppη [3] can not be described in this way — the data is shown in Fig. 4.

To resolve the discrepancy it was speculated that either there is a significant ηN interaction [31], not captured by the model of Ref. [29]. On the contrary, Deloff argued that there might be a significant energy dependence of the production operator [32], and in Ref. [33] a significant contribution of NN P–waves were proposed as a possible solution for the puzzle.
However, such a dependence would emerge from all three explanations. Fortunately it is possible to isolate the NN P–waves by a double polarized measurement.
It should be clear that only when the partial wave decomposition of the ppη spectrum is known, we can understand the role the ηN interaction plays here.

artifact.status_search_result: Several proposed resolutions exist (Deloff's energy-dependent production operator, enhanced ηN interaction, NN P-wave contributions), and partial-wave analyses with later COSY-11/WASA-at-COSY invariant-mass data at Q = 10, 15.5 and 40 MeV constrain these. However, no consensus mechanism has been firmly established; the full partial-wave decomposition requires the double-polarization observable A_xx, which had not been definitively measured/analyzed to uniquely fix the role of NN P-waves and the ηN interaction. The puzzle thus remains essentially open.

status_evidence.title: Phenomenology of pp→ppη reaction close to threshold (Deloff)
status_evidence.snippet: p-p and p-η effective-mass spectra reproduced by lifting on-shell approximation and allowing linear energy dependence in the leading 3P0→1S0,s amplitude.
status_evidence.claim: Deloff proposed energy dependence of the production operator as a possible mechanism.

status_evidence.title: Invariant-mass distributions for pp → ppη at Q = 10 MeV
status_evidence.snippet: Significant enhancements at low pp relative momenta confirmed at Q = 10 MeV, similar to higher excess energies.
status_evidence.claim: The pp invariant-mass enhancement persists across excess energies, with the partial-wave origin still being investigated.

status_evidence.title: Meson production in nucleon-nucleon collisions close to threshold
status_evidence.snippet: Review discusses competing explanations (ηN FSI, energy-dependent operator, NN P-waves) for the pp→ppη puzzle.
status_evidence.claim: The mechanism behind the pp invariant-mass enhancement is still debated.
